title: 2001 AMC 8 Problem 9

concepts.label: Power scaling of length, area, and volume

statement: The large kite is covered with gold foil. The foil is cut from a rectangular piece that just covers the entire grid. How many square inches of waste material are cut off from the four corners?

solutions.text:
The area of the entire grid would be \[ 3 \cdot 7 \cdot 3 \cdot 6 = 378. \] The area of the kite is one-half this area from the formula for the area of the kite, so the wasted material is \(378 \div 2 = 189.\)

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: Tripling both dimensions multiplies area by \(9\)
The waste area equals the large kite area
